detail.description: 4gaBoards 是一个用于实时项目管理的看板系统。在 3.3.9 之前，4gaBoards 允许经过身份验证的用户通过 PATCH /api/users/:id 修改 ssoGoogleId、ssoGoogleEmail、ssoGithubId、ssoGithubUsername、ssoGithubEmail、ssoMicrosoftId、ssoMicrosoftEmail、ssoOidcId 和 ssoOidcEmail。 server/api/controllers/users/update.js 中的白名单批量根据用户输入分配这些后端管理的身份属性。攻击者可以将受害者的提供商标识符放在攻击者控制的帐户上，从而导致在 server/api/helpers/users/get-create-one-for-github-sso.js 等帮助程序中进行默认查找，以在电子邮件链接流运行之前匹配受害者对攻击者帐户的第一次 SSO 登录。受害者登录到攻击者控制的帐户，并且受害者创建的项目、板或数据仍然可以通过攻击者的原始本地凭​​据进行访问。此问题已在 3.3.9 版本中修复。

detail_original.description: 4gaBoards is a boards system for realtime project management. Prior to 3.3.9, 4gaBoards allows an authenticated user to modify ssoGoogleId, ssoGoogleEmail, ssoGithubId, ssoGithubUsername, ssoGithubEmail, ssoMicrosoftId, ssoMicrosoftEmail, ssoOidcId, and ssoOidcEmail through PATCH /api/users/:id. The whitelist in server/api/controllers/users/update.js mass assigns these backend-managed identity attributes from user input. An attacker can place a victim's provider identifier on an attacker-controlled account, causing the default lookup in helpers such as server/api/helpers/users/get-create-one-for-github-sso.js to match the victim's first SSO login to the attacker's account before the email-linkage flow runs. The victim is logged into the attacker-controlled account, and projects, boards, or data the victim creates remain accessible through the attacker's original local credentials. This issue is fixed in version 3.3.9.
